jutsu.name: Opening Strike
jutsu.description: A hit that leaves the target exposed.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user probes %target's guard with a precise strike to the ribs. The blow finds a gap and leaves them exposed to the attacks that follow.

jutsu.name: Enervating Strike
jutsu.description: Shared pool record S28. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user strikes a chakra point on %target with two stiff fingers. Strength drains from their limbs, leaving every technique weaker until it recovers.

jutsu.name: Heavy Cut
jutsu.description: Shared pool record S43. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user draws a heavy cutting arc through %target's defenses, putting their shoulders into the swing. The blade bites deep.

jutsu.name: Suppressing Roar
jutsu.description: Shared pool record B30. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user draws a deep breath and releases a roar laced with chakra that shakes paper from the shoji. %target and everyone beside them are staggered, their attacks weakened by the force of it.

jutsu.name: Rending Strike
jutsu.description: A wound that keeps bleeding.

effects.description: Applies wound damage over multiple turns based on damage dealt

jutsu.battleDescription: %user rends %target open; the wound keeps bleeding.

item.name: Urami Drop
item.description: The tear drops from a fallen Uramaru
item.battleDescription: The tear drops from a fallen Uramaru

jutsu.name: Surging Overflow
jutsu.description: Shared pool record B20. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user opens the gates of their chakra and lets it flow freely through their body. Power floods their limbs, sharpening their strikes and strengthening every movement.

jutsu.name: Steady Strike
jutsu.description: Shared pool record S41. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user holds their footing and lands a steady, deliberate blow on %target. It is the patient strike of a fighter who has drilled it ten thousand times.

jutsu.name: Braced Stance
jutsu.description: A posture that absorbs punishment.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user braces to absorb the coming blows.

jutsu.name: Erupting Ground
jutsu.description: Shared pool record A3. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user forms the Boar seal and pours chakra deep into the earth beneath %target. The ground heaves and bursts upward in a column of rock and soil, battering everyone caught above it.

jutsu.name: Counter Stance
jutsu.description: A posture that returns what it receives.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user takes a counter stance; what strikes them answers for it.

jutsu.name: Warrior's Poise
jutsu.description: Shared pool record B19. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user plants their feet and settles their breathing, drawing chakra evenly through every limb. Their strikes come sharper and their guard stands firmer, the poise of a seasoned swordsman.

item.name: Night's Testament
item.description: “When the sun bears witness, this blade sleeps. When night falls, it remembers.”  Night’s Testament is not forged for war, but for judgment. Its edge is blackened not by fire, but by vows — each strike binding the wielder to the truth of what they’ve done. The markings along the blade are not decoration; they are testaments, etched as memories of every oath fulfilled and every silence kept.  In Seichi, it is said that:  the blade grows heavier with lies,  lighter with resolve,  and will not draw blood unless the wielder’s intent is absolute.  Those who survive its cut remember nothing. Those who fall become part of it.

jutsu.battleDescription: %user forms the Boar seal and pours chakra deep into the earth beneath %target. The ground heaves and bursts upward in a column of rock and soil, battering everyone caught above it.

jutsu.name: Harrying Shot
jutsu.description: Constant fire that gives no room to run.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user harries %target with relentless fire.

jutsu.name: Sovereign Undertow
jutsu.description: Shared pool record B03. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user plunges a hand into the earth and twists, turning the ground beneath %target into a dragging current of chakra. Before they can brace, %target is hauled across the battlefield like driftwood in a flood.

jutsu.name: Warrior's Poise
jutsu.description: Shared pool record B19. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user plants their feet and settles their breathing, drawing chakra evenly through every limb. Their strikes come sharper and their guard stands firmer, the poise of a seasoned swordsman.
